entries.title: Tax rounding assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The tax calculation truncates instead of rounding half up. Correct the tax rounding implementation.

entries.title: Discount rounding assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The discount calculation rounds each item before summing rather than rounding the total. Correct the discount aggregation.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Another monetary assertion fails with similar expected and actual values, but in discount aggregation rather than tax rounding.

entries.title: Archive endpoint is unset
entries.root_cause: REEF_ARCHIVE_URL is not set in the archive integration test environment. Set that variable.

entries.title: Metrics endpoint is unset
entries.root_cause: REEF_METRICS_URL is not set in the metrics integration test environment. Set that variable.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same configuration loader rejects a different missing endpoint variable, requiring a separate endpoint setting.
